functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fi_guard_append_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FI_APPEND_ONLY'; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kf_guard_append_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'KF_APPEND_ONLY'; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sp_guard_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'IMMUTABLE_HISTORY' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END $function$
